title: Strategic realignment: ops runs itself, Claude effort goes to research (hypotheses, learning, the AI trader)
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-13 ~07:30Z (strategic planning session) verbatim, framing: 'we have most of our infra built out and stable ... our big gap here is the quality of our actual trading strategies ... realigning our workflow so that most of the regular ops work can happen through the system itself ... limit [Claude ops effort] to verifying the system's reporting and debugging as needed ... separate from new feature builds ... The lion's share of our direct effort should be going into research to improve the system's outcomes (basically, overall pnl) ... estimate how much actual claude power is needed for [ops] ... how much claude power we have per week for the main task ... the most robust research and testing system and workflow ... research>testing>implementation>iteration ... a clear process strategy/doctrine ... Hypothetically, I would want the system to be able to keep going without me indefinitely - researching, testing, implementing, improving - based on clear goals and instructions.' DECISIONS ~07:50Z verbatim: (1) 'I like having the manager session, and I think it's important that it stay on Opus ... Perhaps what we need is for the manager to also keep an assistant manager sonnet lane for managerial tasks that don't require opus (routine supervision).' (2) 'direct claude resources towards hypothesis sourcing and learning ... even these tasks have subtasks which can and should be automated ... claude should be as focused as possible on improving the strategy performance and building the AI trader as opposed to ongoing ops work.' (3) GOAL: 'optimize for net PNL (including prop accounts, which should be graded against return on the initial purchase) - we only have the daily dd right now to worry about'. (4) AUTONOMY: 'The system is already allowed to make tier 2 and 3 decisions autonomously if they are backed by data, but we can refine and expand these permissions'. (5) BUDGET split accepted as a starting point: ~10% ops monitoring / ~20% builds / ~70% research. (6) 'a big part of this review - planning any and all functions that could be automated to take the pressure off the claude budget'. Workstreams: OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY (lane), ASSISTANT-MANAGER (Sonnet supervision lane), RESEARCH-DOCTRINE (draft with the operator). [basis] The ~10%/~20%/~70% figures are TARGET shares of the weekly Claude allowance (operator-accepted starting split), to apply from the week 2026-10-14 through 2026-10-21; they are not measurements. The measured split is being built by OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY over the window 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-13.

observation.what: ops automation inventory landed with a ranked automation backlog; assistant-manager lane live and routines rewired to it; research doctrine agreed with the operator and committed
observation.how_to_check: checklist rows OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY, ASSISTANT-MANAGER, RESEARCH-DOCTRINE + their PRs
